mapper.select:
/* Archive02Mapper.selectArchiveList */ SELECT
, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_NOTICE_FILE NF WHERE NF.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND NF.NOTICE_ID = A.NOTICE_ID ) AS fileCnt FROM TB_NOTICE A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D BD ON BD.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND BD.BAIM_VAL_CD = #{baimValCdForJoin, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND BD.BAIM_VAL_D_CD = A.ARCHIVE_TYPE_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = A.INSERT_NO WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.NOTICE_TYPE = 'ARCHIVE' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND A.ARCHIVE_TYPE_CD = #{archiveTypeCd}
AND ( A.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{titleKeyword}, '%') OR A.CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{titleKeyword}, '%') )
AND A.INSERT_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
AND A.INSERT_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
ORDER BY A.INSERT_DATE DESC, A.NOTICE_ID DESC

/* Archive02Mapper.selectArchiveOne */ SELECT
, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_NOTICE_FILE NF WHERE NF.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND NF.NOTICE_ID = A.NOTICE_ID ) AS fileCnt FROM TB_NOTICE A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_BAIM_VAL_D BD ON BD.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND BD.BAIM_VAL_CD = #{baimValCdForJoin, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND BD.BAIM_VAL_D_CD = A.ARCHIVE_TYPE_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = A.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = A.INSERT_NO WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} AND A.NOTICE_TYPE = 'ARCHIVE' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'

/* Archive02Mapper.selectArchiveFileList */ SELECT NF.FILE_MGMT_CD AS fileMgmtCd , FI.FILE_NM AS fileNm , FI.FILE_EXT AS fileExt , FI.FILE_PATH AS filePath , NF.SORT_IDX AS sortIdx FROM TB_NOTICE_FILE NF INNER JOIN TB_FILE_INFO FI ON FI.CMPNY_CD = NF.CMPNY_CD AND FI.FILE_MGMT_CD = NF.FILE_MGMT_CD INNER JOIN TB_NOTICE N ON N.CMPNY_CD = NF.CMPNY_CD AND N.NOTICE_ID = NF.NOTICE_ID AND N.NOTICE_TYPE = 'ARCHIVE' AND N.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE NF.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND NF.NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} ORDER BY NF.SORT_IDX ASC, NF.FILE_MGMT_CD ASC

/* Archive02Mapper.selectNextArchiveId */ SELECT CONCAT( 'A' , DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') , LPAD( IFNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTR(A.NOTICE_ID, 10, 3) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1 , 3, '0' ) ) FROM TB_NOTICE A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.NOTICE_TYPE = 'ARCHIVE' AND A.NOTICE_ID LIKE CONCAT('A', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), '%')
mapper.insert: /* Archive02Mapper.insertArchive */ INSERT INTO TB_NOTICE ( CMPNY_CD , NOTICE_ID , NOTICE_TYPE , ARCHIVE_TYPE_CD , TITLE , CONTENT , EDIT_PWD , TARGET_SCOPE , INCLUDE_DAILY_YN , POPUP_YN , POPUP_FROM_YMD , POPUP_TO_YMD , PIN_YN , PIN_ORDER , DEL_YN , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE ) VALUES ( #{gvCmpnyCd} , #{noticeId} , 'ARCHIVE' , #{archiveTypeCd} , #{title} , #{content} , #{editPwdHash} , 'ALL' , 'N' , 'N' , NULL , NULL , 'N' , NULL , 'N' , #{gvUserCd} , NOW() )
mapper.select: /* Archive02Mapper.selectArchiveForUpdate */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.NOTICE_ID AS noticeId , A.ARCHIVE_TYPE_CD AS archiveTypeCd , NULL AS archiveTypeNm , A.TITLE AS title , A.CONTENT AS content , A.INSERT_NO AS insertNo , DATE_FORMAT(A.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS insertDate , NULL AS insertUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(A.UPDATE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updateDate , 0 AS fileCnt FROM TB_NOTICE A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} AND A.NOTICE_TYPE = 'ARCHIVE' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'
